hints.title: Fixed First Machine Position
hints.text: Notice that the initial machine must be unlocked before any remaining machines can be activated.

hints.title: Remaining Elements Ordering
hints.text: The remaining n minus one machines can be ordered in any permutation without violating precedence.

hints.title: Modular Factorial Computation
hints.text: Compute the factorial of n minus one under the specified modulo arithmetic.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations recursively exceeds memory and time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modular multiplication loop avoids storing intermediate states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that fixing the root reduces the problem to (n - 1)! possibilities.
